implementation: older Python GM01 actual fresh-RGB encoder/decoder control
reference_policy: immutable reconstructed key; P never advances reference
feedback_policy: immediate in-process ACK after successful receive; no serialized ACK bytes

stream.framing: concatenated complete GM01 packets; packet offsets and lengths in records

timing_scope: measured Python wall time; encode analyze+candidate+commit; decode receive; excludes verification hashes/reconstruction, file IO and ACK; no FPGA cycle or FPS inference

reference_memory.scope: retained immutable key only; excludes source/output/candidate/coefficient arrays, packet storage and Python allocator overhead; no physical RAM proof

color_contract: same fixed_codec.rgb_to_planes / planes_to_rgb used by python-game-standard-study/common_color.py via b.gm.ft; full-range integer YUV420
